mapper.select: SELECT t.TRD_SN AS tradeId, t.SLLR_USR_SN AS sellerUserId, t.BYPR_USR_SN AS buyerUserId, t.TRD_STATUS_CD AS tradeStatus, t.TRD_METHOD_CD AS tradeMethod FROM TRADE t WHERE t.TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' AND t.TRD_METHOD_CD = 'TRDC0010' AND (t.SLLR_USR_SN = #{userId} OR t.BYPR_USR_SN = #{userId}) FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.TRD_SN AS tradeId, t.SLLR_USR_SN AS sellerUserId, t.BYPR_USR_SN AS buyerUserId, t.TRD_STATUS_CD AS tradeStatus, t.TRD_METHOD_CD AS tradeMethod FROM TRADE t WHERE t.TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' AND t.TRD_METHOD_CD = 'TRDC0010' AND (t.SLLR_USR_SN = #{userId} OR t.BYPR_USR_SN = #{userId})

SELECT p.TRD_OFL_PPS_SN AS proposalId, p.TRD_SN AS tradeId, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_TYPE_CD AS proposalType, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_STATUS_CD AS proposalStatus, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_PROPOSER_USR_SN AS proposerUserId, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_RESPONDER_USR_SN AS responderUserId, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_DT AS meetingDateTime, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_PLC_NM AS meetingPlace, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_ADDR_ENC AS meetingAddress, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_RSN_CN AS reason, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_RESP_DT AS respondedAt FROM TRADE_OFFLINE_PROPOSAL p WHERE p.TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND p.TRD_OFL_PPS_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0025' ORDER BY p.TRD_OFL_PPS_SN DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.TRD_OFL_PPS_SN AS proposalId, p.TRD_SN AS tradeId, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_TYPE_CD AS proposalType, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_STATUS_CD AS proposalStatus, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_PROPOSER_USR_SN AS proposerUserId, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_RESPONDER_USR_SN AS responderUserId, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_DT AS meetingDateTime, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_PLC_NM AS meetingPlace, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_ADDR_ENC AS meetingAddress, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_RSN_CN AS reason, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_RESP_DT AS respondedAt FROM TRADE_OFFLINE_PROPOSAL p WHERE p.TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND p.TRD_OFL_PPS_SN = #{proposalId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRADE_OFFLINE_PROPOSAL ( TRD_SN, TRD_OFL_PPS_TYPE_CD, TRD_OFL_PPS_STATUS_CD, TRD_OFL_PPS_PROPOSER_USR_SN, TRD_OFL_PPS_DT, TRD_OFL_PPS_PLC_NM, TRD_OFL_PPS_ADDR_ENC ) VALUES ( #{tradeId}, #{proposalType}, 'TRDC0025', #{proposerUserId}, #{meetingDateTime}, #{meetingPlace}, #{meetingAddress} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TRADE_OFFLINE_PROPOSAL SET TRD_OFL_PPS_STATUS_CD = #{statusCode}, TRD_OFL_PPS_RESPONDER_USR_SN = #{responderUserId}, TRD_OFL_PPS_RSN_CN = #{reason}, TRD_OFL_PPS_RESP_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, TRD_OFL_PPS_UPDT_ID = CAST(#{responderUserId} AS CHAR) WHERE TRD_OFL_PPS_SN = #{proposalId} AND TRD_OFL_PPS_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0025'

UPDATE TRADE_OFFLINE_PROPOSAL SET TRD_OFL_PPS_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0029', TRD_OFL_PPS_UPDT_ID = 'SYSTEM' WHERE TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND TRD_OFL_PPS_SN <> #{proposalId} AND TRD_OFL_PPS_TYPE_CD IN ('TRDC0030', 'TRDC0031') AND TRD_OFL_PPS_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0026'
mapper.select: SELECT p.TRD_OFL_PPS_SN AS proposalId, p.TRD_SN AS tradeId, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_TYPE_CD AS proposalType, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_STATUS_CD AS proposalStatus, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_PROPOSER_USR_SN AS proposerUserId, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_RESPONDER_USR_SN AS responderUserId, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_DT AS meetingDateTime, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_PLC_NM AS meetingPlace, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_ADDR_ENC AS meetingAddress, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_RSN_CN AS reason, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_RESP_DT AS respondedAt FROM TRADE_OFFLINE_PROPOSAL p WHERE p.TRD_SN = #{tradeId} ORDER BY p.TRD_OFL_PPS_REG_DT DESC, p.TRD_OFL_PPS_SN DESC
